testcase.name: Scenario: ellipse-10 Cancel a curvature-density preview: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/sketch/ellipse/scenario.feature:99:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: ellipse-10 Cancel a curvature-density preview ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view ✔ And the user enables Display Curvature on the ellipse ✔ Given the ellipse has Display Curvature enabled ✔ When the user choose Setup Curvature Display from its context menu ✔ Then Curvature Settings shows two Minimum-to-Maximum sliders without numeric values ✔ And OK and Apply are initially disabled ✔ When the user advance the upper slider ✔ Then the thumb advances and the comb becomes denser ✔ And OK and Apply become enabled ✔ When the user click Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes and the earlier sparse comb returns ✔ And curvature display stays enabled
